entities.name: Diagnostic ureteroscopy
observations: Pre-RNU ureteroscopy is associated with higher subsequent intravesical recurrence in pooled observational studies; adjusted cohort estimates are often positive but not uniform.
The association is strongest for ureteroscopic biopsy and delayed RNU after ureteroscopy; confounding by indication remains plausible.

entities.name: Upper tract urothelial carcinoma
observations: Patients undergoing radical nephroureterectomy are the studied population for evaluating post-operative intravesical recurrence after diagnostic ureteroscopy.

entities.name: Intravesical recurrence
observations: Pre-RNU ureteroscopy was associated with pooled hazard ratios of 1.56 and 1.44 in retrospective meta-analyses; one adjusted cohort reported HR 1.413 (95% CI 1.015–1.965).
A 2021 cohort found ureteroscopic biopsy HR 1.40, while URS without biopsy HR 1.15 and percutaneous biopsy HR 1.07 were not significant.
A 2023 cohort found delayed RNU after URS HR 1.98 (95% CI 1.08–3.65) versus no URS; a 2024 registry reported HR 1.705 (95% CI 1.082–2.688).
A 2018 institutional cohort was null and a population cohort was borderline (HR 1.136, P=0.059), demonstrating inconsistent evidence.
